description: Danica is a consumer protection and antitrust attorney, an expert on AI safety and child protection, and community advocate. She is also proud PTA mom of three kids, and the daughter of a farmworker who was first in her family to go to college. Because experience and representation matter, she is running to serve the 32nd legislative district in Olympia.
